<observations>
Date: Mar 11, 2026
* 🔴 (07:15) User stated preferences: PostgreSQL backend, TypeScript with strict linting, cloud budget capped at $1,850, and deferring recurring invoices until post-beta.
* ✅ (10:30) Fixed null reference error in invoice PDF generator (`pdfGenerator.ts`).
* 🟡 (13:15) Created `feature/stripe-integration` branch and added stub for recurring invoices.

Date: Mar 14, 2026
* 🔴 (07:30) User requested webhook support, env vars prefixed with `LEDGERLY_`, and public launch on April 23, 2026.
* ✅ (16:55) Implemented Stripe webhook handler with signature verification, retry utility, Winston logging, and tests (98% coverage).
* ✅ (21:55) Merged webhook support PR after approval.

Date: Mar 20, 2026
* 🔴 (07:30) User stated requirement for EUR/GBP invoicing and updated public launch date to May 10, 2026.
* ✅ (11:00) Implemented multi-currency support (EUR, GBP, USD) and PDF invoice rendering.
* ✅ (20:45) Configured SendGrid email service, deployed multi-currency staging build, and shared URL with QA.

Date: Mar 24, 2026
* 🔴 (07:15) User requested Google and GitHub OAuth login support.
* ✅ (09:55) Implemented and merged OAuth login feature.
* ✅ (13:05) Built analytics reporting dashboard with CSV export and added nightly S3 backup to CI.

Date: Mar 28, 2026
* 🔴 (17:45) User set standing rule: never push directly to `main`, always open a pull request.
* ✅ (16:35) Refactored invoice rendering service, added Stripe/PayPal feature toggle, and merged payment feature.
* ✅ (19:20) Added tiered revenue analytics query and deployed latest build to EC2 staging (`ledgerly-stg-01`).
</observations>

<current-task>
- Primary: Ledgerly project development is active (staging build deployed on EC2 `ledgerly-stg-01`, public launch set for May 10, 2026).
- Standing rules: Always open a pull request (never push directly to `main`).
</current-task>

The assistant should wait for the user to respond before continuing.
</suggested-response>
